Name: Lighter
Desc: Use it to obtain the Agent or unlock the Agent's Mindscapes.
Desc2:
Snapshots from Lighter's daily life and from in combat, recording important moments before and after he became an Agent.
These images also provide insights into his fighting style and favorite weapons, helping to better understand his strengths.

Video of Lighter's participation in an underground fighting ring. As expected of the The Champion, his win rate is almost absurdly high...
